ityarthaḥ|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| yathā sattvamupekṣya svaṃ śanairvipro durīhayā| aṅgīkaroti śūdratvaṃ tathā jīvatvamīśvaraḥ|| yatheti|| yathā hi kaścidvipraḥ svamātmīyaṃ sattvaṃ jātyādibhiḥ praśastatvamupekṣyāvicārya durīhayā putrotpādanaparyantaśūdrāṅganāsaṅgādirūpayā duśceṣṭayā śūdratvamaṅgīkaroti| tathāca manuḥ -- `śūdrāṃ śayanamāropya brāhmaṇo yātyadhogatim| janayitvā sutaṃ tasyāṃ brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate' iti| tathā durīhayā svasaṃkalpena svāvidyayā vā īśvaro'pi jīvatvamaṅgīkaroti| `anena jīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇī'ti śruteḥ|| bhūtāni dvividhānyeva pratisarge sphuranti vai| ādyacitspandajātāni tāni niṣkāraṇāni vai|| bhūtānīti ślokadvayaṃ sārdhaṃ vākyam|| dvividhānyeva bhūtāni carācararūpāḥ prāṇinaḥ pratisargaṃ sphuranti prādurbhavanti| tatra yāni bhūtāni ādyacitspandajātāni| spandaḥ sphuraṇaṃ sisṛkṣeti yāvat| ādyacitspandājjātāni bhūtāni niṣkāraṇāni karmāderjanamakāraṇasyābhāvāt ātmanaśca nirvikāratvenākāraṇatvāt|| īśvarātsamupāgatya punarjanmāntarāṇi tu| bhūtānyanubhavantyaṅga svakṛtaireva karmabhiḥ| kāryakāraṇabhāvo'yamīdṛśo janmakarmabhiḥ|| īśvarātsamupāgatya tu bhūtāni svakṛtaiḥ karmabhireva punaḥpunarjanmāntarāṇi anubhavanti| janmakarmaṇorayaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāva īdṛśaḥ uktaprakāraḥ prathamaṃ janma karmaṇaḥ sukṛtaduṣkṛtarūpasya kāraṇam| anantaraṃ tu karma janmano nāmarūpasya kāraṇamityarthaḥ|| akāraṇamupāyānti sarve jīvāḥ parāspadāt| paścātteṣāṃ svakarmāṇi kāraṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ|| ātmājñānātsamutpannaḥ saṃkalpaḥ karmakāraṇam|| saṃkalpitvaṃ hi bandhasya kāraṇaṃ tatparityaja| mokṣastu niḥsaṃkalpitvaṃ tadabhyāsaṃ dhiyā kuru|| etadeva spaṣṭayati -- akāraṇamiti ardhatrayaṃ vākyam|| sukhaduḥkhayorityupalakṣaṇam| jātyāyuṣorapi nānārūpayoḥ svakarmāṇyeva kāraṇam| ātmājñānāt ātmatattvasyājñānāt samutpannaḥ saṃkalpastu karmaṇāṃ kāraṇam|| sāvadhāno bhava tvaṃ ca grāhyagrāhakasaṃgame| ajasrameva saṃkalpadaśāḥ pariharañśanaiḥ|| sāvadhāna iti|| caśabdo hetvarthe| ato hetoḥ svasaṃkalpadaśāḥ śanairabhyāsakrameṇa pariharan grāhyagrāhakasaṃgame dṛśyadarśanasaṃbandhe ajasrameva sāvadhāno bhava avyavahito bhava|| mā bhava grāhyabhāvātmā grāhakātmā ca mā bhava| bhāvanāmakhilāṃ tyaktvā yacchiṣṭaṃ tanmayo bhava|| avadhānaprakāramevāha -- mā bhaveti|| grāhyabhāvātmā dṛśyabhāvādātmā'bhimānī mā bhava| grāhakātmā draṣṭṛtvābhimānī mā bhava kiṃtarhi akhilānāṃ bhāvānāṃ karmakartrādivāsanāṃ tyaktvā yacchiṣṭaṃ vastu karmādivilakṣaṇaṃ tanmayo bhava|| ajasraṃ yaṃ yamevārthaṃ patatyakṣagaṇo'nagha| badhyate tatra rāgeṇa virāgeṇa vimucyate|| ajasramiti|| akṣagaṇaḥ indriyasamūhoyaṃ yamevārthamajasraṃ patati gacchati tatra rāgeṇa cetpatati tarhī badhyate| virāgeṇa cetpatati tarhī vimucyate|| yatkiṃcidrocate citte tadbaddho'si bhavasthitau| na kiṃcidrocate citte tanmukto'si bhavasthitau|| etadevāha -- yaditi|| tasmātpadārthanicayādrāma sthāvarajaṅgamāt| tṛṇāderdevaparyantānmā kiṃcittava rocatām|| aratiḥ sanyadaśnāsi yatkaroṣi jahāsi yat| na kartāsi na bhoktāsi tatra muktamatiḥ śamī|| santo'tītaṃ na śocanti bhaviṣyaccintayanti no| vartamānaṃ ca gṛhṇanti kramaprāptaṃ sadānagha|| manasi grathitāḥ pāśāstṛṣṇāmohamadādayaḥ| manasaiva mano nāma chedanīyaṃ vijānatā|| tasmāditi|| tava tubhyamityarthaḥ|| vivekenātitīkṣṇena balādaya ivāyasā| manasaiva manaśchindhi saṃsārabhrāntiśāntaye|| kṣālayanti malenaiva malaṃ kṣālanakovidāḥ| vārayantyasramasreṇa viṣaṃ prativiṣeṇa ca|| jīvasya trīṇi rūpāṇi sthūlasūkṣmaparāṇi tu| tatrāsya yatparaṃ rūpaṃ tadbhaja dve parityaja|| pāṇipādamayo yo'yaṃ deho bogāya valgati| bhogārthametajjīvasya rūpaṃ sthūlamiha sthitam|| vivekeneti|| vivekena atitīkṣṇaṃ yanmanastena manasā malinaṃ manaśchindhītyarthaḥ|| svasaṃkalpamayākāre yāvatsaṃsārabhāvi yat| cittaṃ tadviddhi jīvasya rūpaṃ rāmātivāhikam|| ādyantarahitaṃ satyaṃ cinmātraṃ nirvikalpakam| yattadviddhiparaṃ rūpaṃ jīvasyādyaṃ tṛtīyakam|| sveti|| cittamevāsya jīvasya ātivāhikam| lokāntaragamanāgamanayogyaṃ sūkṣmarūpamityarthaḥ|| etatturyapadaṃ śuddhamatra baddhapado bhava| saṃparityajya pūrve dve mā tatrātmamatirbhava|| etaditi|| turīyaṃ sthūlasūkṣmakāraṇaśarīrāpekṣayā caturtham|| rāma uvāca|| jāgratsvapnasuṣupteṣu sthitaṃ triṣvapyalakṣitam| turyaṃ brūhi viśeṣeṇa vivicya munināyaka|| jāgraditi|| jāgradādiṣu triṣu sthitaṃ avasthitamapi jāgradādibhiralakṣitaṃ avaśeṣitaṃ asaṃspandaṃ turyaṃ brūhītyarthaḥ|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| ahaṃbhāvānahaṃbhāvau tyaktvā sadasatī tathā| yadasaṃsaktamasvacchaṃ sthitaṃ tattaryamucyate|| ahamiti|| yaccaitanyaṃ ahaṃbhāvānahaṃbhāvau ahaṃ nāhamiti cābhimānaṃ sadasatī sattvāsattvābhimānaṃ ca tyaktvā asaṃsaktaṃ svacchaṃ ca sthitaṃ tattādṛśacaitanyaṃ turyamucyate|| yā svacchā samatā śāntā jīvanmuktavyavasthitiḥ| sākṣyavasthā vyavahṛtau sā turyakalanocyate|| yeti|| svacchā niṣkalaṅkā samatayā śāntatayā ca jīvanmuktasya sthitirūpāyāṃ vyavahṛtau sākṣyavasthā audāsīnyāvasthā sā turyakalanā turyāvasthocyate|| naitajjāgranna ca svapnaḥ saṃkalpānāmasaṃbhavāt| suṣuptabhāvo nāpyetadabhāvājjaḍatāsthiteḥ|| naitaditi|| etatturyapadaṃ jāgranna svapnaśca na saṃkalpānāmabhāvāt| etatsuṣuptabhāvo'pi na jaḍatāsthiterabhāvāt|| śāntasamyakprabuddhānāṃ yathāsthitamidaṃ jagat| vilīnaṃ turyamityāhurabuddhānāṃ sthiraṃ sthitam|| śānteti|| śāntā ye samyak prabuddhāḥ teṣāṃ yathāstitamevedaṃ jagat brahmaṇi vilīnaṃ tatturyamityāhuḥ| abuddhānāṃ tu sthirameva sthitam|| ahaṃkārakalātyāge samatāyāḥ samudgame| viśarārau kṛte citte turyāvasthopatiṣṭhate|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| athemaṃ śṛṇu dṛṣṭāntaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayādhunā| prabuddho'pi yathā bodhamupaiṣi vibudhopama|| ahamiti|| viśarārau viśaraṇaśīle|| kasmiṃścitkānanābhoge mahāmaunavyavasthitam| dṛṣṭvādbhutamidaṃ kiṃcinmuniṃ papraccha lubdhakaḥ|| paścādupagato bāṇabhinnaṃ mṛgamabhidrutam| mune madīyabāṇena viddho mṛga ihāgataḥ| kva prayāto mṛga iti pratyuvāca sa taṃ muniḥ|| kasminniti|| mahāmaunavyavasthitam| mahāmaunaṃ nāma dvaitaprapañcānanusaṃdhānam|| samaśīlā vayaṃ sādho munayo vanavāsinaḥ| nāsmākamastyahaṃkāro vyavahāreṣu yaḥ kṣamaḥ|| sarvāṇīndriyakarmāṇi karotīha sakhe manaḥ| ahaṃkāramayaṃ tanme nūnaṃ pragalitaṃ ciram|| sameti|| samaśīlāḥ samaṃ brahmaiva śīlayantyanusaṃdadhatta iti samaśīlāḥ| śīla samādhāviti dhātuḥ|| jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyā daśā vedmi na kāścana| turya evāvatiṣṭhe'haṃ tatra dṛśyaṃ na vidyate|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā munimukhyasya rāghava| lubdhako'rthamavijñāya jagāmābhimatāṃ diśam|| jāgraditi|| turye pūrvoktāyāṃ turyāvasthāyām|| ato vacmi mahābāho nāsti turyetarā daśā| nirvikalpā hi citturyaṃ tadevāstīha netaram|| ata iti|| turyetarā turyavyatiriktā daśā vastuto nāsti kalpitatvāt| hi yasmātkāraṇāt nirvikalpā cideva turyam|| jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyaṃ trayaṃ rūpaṃ hi cetasaḥ| śāntaṃ ghoraṃ ca mūḍhaṃ ca tryātma cittamiha sthitam|| jāgraditi|| hi yasmātkāraṇāt jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyaṃ trayaṃ cetasa eva rūpaṃ avasthā nātmano'to ghoraṃ śāntaṃ mūḍhaṃ ceti jāgradādiṣu cittaṃ tryātma traya ātmānaḥ svabhāvā yasya tādṛśaṃ sthitam|| ghoraṃ jāgranmayaṃ cittaṃ śāntaṃ svapnamayaṃ sthitam| mūḍhaṃ suṣuptabhāvasthaṃ tribhirhīnaṃ mṛtaṃ bhavet|| etadeva vivṛṇoti -- jāgranmayaṃ cittaṃ ghoraṃ bhavet sukhaduḥkhasaṃrambhabāhulyāt| svapnamayaṃ cittaṃ śāntaṃ tathāvidhasaṃrambhābhāvāt| suṣuptabhāvasthaṃ mūḍhaṃ jāḍyabhūyiṣṭhatvāt| tribhiḥ śāntadirūpaiḥ hīnaṃ tu cittaṃ mṛtaṃ bhavet nirvikāratvāt|| yacca cittaṃ mṛtaṃ yacca sattvamekaṃ sthitaṃ samam| tadeva yoginaḥ sarve yatnātsaṃpādayanti hi|| yacceti| yacca cittaṃ tadeva cittaṃ samamekaṃ ca sattvaṃ sattvaguṇarūpaṃ sthitam| atastadeva cittaṃ sarve yogino yatnātsaṃpādayanti|| samastasaṃkalpavilāsamukte turye pade tiṣṭha nirāmayātmā| yatra sthitāḥ sādhu sadaiva muktāḥ praśāntabhedā munayo mahāntaḥ|| iti śrīyogavāsiṣṭhasāre nirvāṇaprakaraṇe munivyādhopākhyānaṃ nāma caturdaśaḥ sargaḥ|| 14 || samasteti|| yatraca yasmiṃsturye pade|| iti śrīyogavāsiṣṭhavivaraṇe nirvāmaprakaraṇe munivyādhopākhyānaṃ nāma caturdaśaḥ sargaḥ|| 14 || <6.15> yogasaptabhūmikopākhyānam|| pañcadaśaḥ sargaḥ|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| siddhānto'dhyātmaśāstrāṇāṃ sarvāpahnava eva hi| nāvidyāstīha no māyā śāntaṃ brahmedamagrimam|| pūrvaṃ viśrāntasya bāhyavyavahārabhāro nāstīti darśitam| idānīṃ sarvasya cāsya jñānaśāstrasya jñānabhūmikāsāratvāt tatsvarūpaṃ vistarema nirūpayituṃ antimamidamākhyānamārabhyate -- siddhānta iti|| śāntamagrimamidaṃ brahmaivāsti avidyā māyā tatkāryaṃ ca nāstīti sarvaprapañcāpahnava evādhyātmaśāstrāṇāṃ siddhāntaḥ|| śānta eva cidākāśe svasthe samasamātmani| samagraśaktikhacite brahmeti kalitābhidhe|| nirṇīya kecicchūnyatvaṃ kecidvijñānamātratām| kecidiśvararūpatvaṃ vivadante parasparam|| śānta iti ślokadvayaṃ vākyam|| śāntādilakṣaṇe brahmeti kalitābhidhe cidākāśa eva kecidvādinaḥ śūnyatvaṃ kecittu vijñānamātratāṃ kecitpunarīśvararūpatvaṃ nirṇīya parasparaṃ vivadante|| sarvameva parityajya mahāmaunī bhavānagha| nirvāṇavānnirmananaḥ kṣīṇacittaḥ praśāntadhīḥ|| sarvamiti|| tvaṃ ca sarvameva vivādaṃ parityajya nirmanano niḥsaṃkalpavikalpaḥ kṣīṇacitto nirvāsanacittaḥ praśāntadhīśca san mahāmaunī bāhyamananusaṃdadhan nirvāṇavān jīvanmukto bhava|| ātmanyeva praśāntātmā mūkāndhabadhiropamaḥ| nityamantarmukho bhūtvā tvamāsvāntaḥ prapūrṇadhīḥ|| ātmanīti|| tvaṃ nityamantarmukho bhūtvā ātmanyeva praśāntātmā nirvṛtacittaḥ mūkāndhabadhiropamaḥ cittasyāntarmukhatvāt niṣphalabāhyendriyavyāpāraḥ antaḥ prapūrṇadhīrāsva tiṣṭha|| jāgratyeva suṣuptasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi rāghava| antaḥ sarvaparityāgī bahiḥ kuru yathāgatam|| jāgratīti|| jāgratyeva satyeva bāhyendriyavyāpāre suṣuptastho nirvikāracittaḥ karmaṇi kuru| tadeva spaṣṭayati -- antaḥ sarvaparityāgī rāgadveṣādikaṃ sarvaṃ parityajya bahiryathāgataṃ yathāprāptaṃ karma kuru|| cittasattā paraṃ duḥkhaṃ cittāsattā paraṃ sukham| antaścittaṃ cidekātmā naya kṣayamavedanāt|| citteti|| yataścittasattāsatte eva pare duḥkhasukhe| ataścidekātmā cidekarasaḥ san avedanāt bāhyānanusaṃdhānāddhetościttaṃ kṣayaṃ naya|| dṛṣṭvā ramyamaramyaṃ vā stheyaṃ pāṣāṇavatsamam| etāvatātmayatnena jitā bhavati saṃsṛtiḥ|| dṛṣṭveti|| ramyamaramyaṃ vā dṛṣṭvā pāṣāṇavat samaṃ nirvikāraṃ stheyam| etāvataivātmayatnena saṃsṛtirjitā bhavati|| saṃvedanīyaṃ na sukhaṃ nāsukhaṃ naiva madhyamam| etāvatātmayatnena duḥkhānto'nanta āpyate|| saṃvedanīyamiti|| sukhametat duḥkhametat madhyamamanubhavarūpametaditi tritayamapi na saṃvedanīyaṃ nānusaṃdhānīyam| etāvatātmayatnena ananto duḥkhāntaḥ ātyantikī duḥkhanivṛttirāpyate|| āpīnamaṇḍalaśaśāṅkavadantareva śrīmadrasāyanamayaḥ sukhameti tajjñaḥ| vijñātasarvabhuvanatrayavastusāraḥ kurvanna nāma kurute paramabhyupetaḥ|| rāma uvāca|| saptānāṃ yogabhūmīnāmabhyāsaḥ kriyate katham| kīdṛśāni ca cihnāni bhūmikāṃ prati yoginaḥ|| āpīneti|| āpīnamaṇḍalaśaśāṅgavat pūrṇenduvattajjñaḥ antaḥ śrīmadrasāyanamayaḥ amṛtamayaḥ sukhaṃ svarūpasukhameti| vijñātasarvabhuvanayavastusāraḥ tajjñaḥ paraṃ paramātmānaṃ abhyupetaḥ karmāṇi kurvannapi na nāma kurute na kuruta eva abhimānābhāvāt|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| pravṛttaśca nivṛttaśca bhavati dvividhaḥ pumān| svargāpavargonmukhayoḥ śṛṇu lakṣametayoḥ|| pravṛtta iti|| svargāpavargonmukhayoḥ sakāmadharmānuṣṭhānena svargonmukhaḥ pravṛttaḥ| niṣkāmadharmānuṣṭhānenāpavargonmukho nivṛttaḥ|| kiyattannāma nirvāṇaṃ varaṃ saṃsṛtireva me| iti nirṇīya kartā yaḥ sa pravṛtta udāhṛtaḥ|| kiyaditi|| tat nirvāṇaṃ nāma kiyat alpameva| bhoktavyasya vastvantarasyābhāvāt| saṃsṛtireva me varaṃ prārthadhanīyaṃ vastu bhoktavyānāṃ viṣayasukhānāmānantyāt| iti nirṇīya yaḥ pravṛttihetubhūtāni karmāṇi kartā sa pumānpravṛtta udāhṛtaḥ|| calārmavayugacchidrakūrmagrīvāpraveśavat| anekajanmanāmante vivekī jāyate pumān|| caleti|| calārmavayugacchidrakūrmagrīvāpraveśavat calayorarṇavayoryugasya yugmasya chidre madhyavartitīravivare kūrmasya grīvayā sādhanabhūtayā praveśe sati yathā purato nirgamane paścānnivartate tathaiva chidrāvasthāne vā naca kvāpi viśrāntiḥ tathā prāktanaṃ bhavasāgaraṃ parityajya bhavāntaraṃ pravivikṣorjīvasya na kvāpi viśrāntiḥ| tathāhi| prāktane janmani jarāmaraṇādiduḥkhaparamparā bhāvini bālyādiduḥkhasaṃtatiḥ madhyavartini yātanādehe garbhavāse ca mahat duḥkhamiti| itthaṃ duḥkhamayānāṃ anekeṣāṃ janmanāṃ ante pumān kutaścit puṇyaparipākāt vivekī jāyate|| asārā bata saṃsāravyavasthālaṃ mamaitayā| kiṃ karmabhiḥ paryuṣitaurdinaṃ taireva nīyate|| asāreti|| saṃsāravyavasthā asārā niḥsārā bata| mama etayā saṃsāravyavasthayā alam| paryuṣitairgatasāraiḥ karmabhirapi kiṃ phalaṃ kimiti taireva paryuṣitaiḥ karmabhirdinamakhilaṃ nīyate|| kriyātiśayanirmuktaṃ kiṃ syādviśramaṇaṃ param| iti niścayavānyo'ntaḥ sa nivṛtta iti smṛtaḥ|| kriyātiśayeti|| kriyātiśayena nirmuktaṃ karmaphalatāratamyarahitaṃ paramutkṛṣṭaṃ viśramaṇaṃ kiṃ syāt ityevamantarniścayavān yo mumukṣuḥ sa nivṛtta iti smṛtaḥ|| kathaṃ virāgavānbhūtvā saṃsārābdhiṃ tarāmyaham| evaṃ vicāraṇaparo yadā bhavati sanmatiḥ|| kathamiti ślokaṣaṭkaṃ vākyam|| virāgo vairāgyam|| virāgamupayātyantarvāsanāsvanuvāsaram| kriyāsūdārarupāsu kramate modate'nvaham|| anuvāsaraṃ pratidinaṃ vāsanāsu virāgamupayāti| udārarūpāsu praśastāsu kramate kartumutsahate| `vṛttisargatāyaneṣu kramaḥ' ityātmanepadam|| grāmyāsu jaḍaceṣṭāsu satataṃ vicikitsati| nodāharati marmāṇi puṇyakarmāṇi sevate|| grāmyāsviti|| grāmyāsu grāme bhavāsu jaḍānāṃ ceṣṭāsu kṛṣyādiṣu vicikitsati saṃśayena yukta ityarthaḥ| pareṣāṃ marmāṇi nodāharati noddhāṭayati| `na kaṃcinmarmaṇi spṛśet' iti niṣedhāt|| ananyodvegakārīṇi mṛdukarmāṇi sevate| pāpādbibheti satataṃ na ca bhogamapekṣate|| ananyoddhegakārīṇi anyeṣāmabhayaṃkarāṇi| mṛdukarmāṇi ahiṃsrāṇi karmāṇi|| snehapraṇayagarbhāṇi peśalānyucitāni ca| deśakālopapannāni vacanānyabhibhāṣate| tadāsau prathamāmekāṃ prāpto bhavati bhūmikām|| snehapraṇayagarbhāṇi snehaḥ premā praṇayo viśrambhastadgarbhāṇi|| manasā karmaṇā vācā sajjanānupasevate| yataḥkutaścidānīya jñānaśāstrāṇyavekṣate|| manasā vācā ca sajjanān jñānina upasevate śuśrūṣate| itthamācaransanmatiḥ prathamāṃ śubhecchārūpāmekāṃ bhūmikāṃ prāpto bhavatītyanvayaḥ|| evaṃ vicāravānyaḥ syātsaṃsārottaraṇaṃ prati| sa bhūmikāvānityuktaḥ śeṣastvārya iti smṛtaḥ|| evamiti|| saṃsārottaraṇaṃ prati evaṃ pūrvoktaprakāreṇa yo vicāravānsyāt sa eva bhūmikāvānityuktaḥ prathamabhūmīkāṃ prāpta ityucyate| śeṣastu sanmārgavartī ārya iti smṛtaḥ|| vicāranāmnīmitarāmāgato yogabhūmikām| śrutismṛtisadācāradhāraṇādhyānakarmaṇaḥ| mukhyayā vyākhyayā khyātāñśrayati śreṣṭhapaṇḍitān|| vicāreti ślokapañcakaṃ vākyam|| śrutismṛtisadācāradhāraṇādhyānakarmaṇaḥ śrutyādayaḥ karmāṇi kartavyāni anusaṃdheyāni ca yeṣāṃ tān| mukhyayā praśastayā vyākhyayā adhyātmaśāstrāṇāṃ vyākhyānena khyātān śreṣṭhapaṇḍitān śrayati| dhyānakarmaṇāmiti pāṭhe nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| śrutyāditatparāṇāṃ madhye ye śreṣṭhāḥ paṇḍitāstān śrayatītyarthaḥ|| padārthapravibhāgajñaḥ kāryākāryavinirṇayam| jānātyadhigataśravyo gṛhaṃ gṛhapatiryathā|| padārthapravibhāgajñaḥ nityānityavastupravibhāgajñaḥ adhigataśravyaḥ śrutādhyātmaśāstraḥ gṛhapatiḥ gṛhamiva kāryākāryavinirṇayaṃ tattvato jānāti|| madābhimānamātsaryadambhamohātiśāyitām| bahipyarthitāmīṣattyajatyahiriva tvacam|| īṣadbahirarthitāṃ sphuritāmapi madābhimānamātsaryadambhamamohātiśāyitāṃ madādīnāmatiśayasaṃpattiṃ ahistvacamiva tyajati|| itthaṃbhūtamatiḥ śāstre gurusajjanasevayā| sa rahasyamaśeṣeṇa yathāvadadhigacchati|| itthaṃbhūtamatiḥ pūrvoktasadvāsanāvāsitamatiḥ saḥ dvitīyabhūmīkāṃ prāpto gurusajjanasevayā sādhanena śāstre rahasyaṃ tattvaṃ yathāvatsamyagadhicchati|| asaṃsaṅgābhidhāmanyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ yogabhūmikām| tataḥ patatyasau kāntaḥ puṣpaśayyāmivāmalām|| asaṃsaṃgeti ślokapañcakaṃ vākyam|| asaṃsaṅgābhidhāṃ tṛtīyāṃ tanumānaseti yā pūrvoktā saiva mānamasya| tanutvādviṣayeṣvāsaṅgābhāvādasaṃsaṅgāmidhāsaṃpanneti na pūrvottaravirodhaḥ|| yathāvacchāstravākyārthe matimādhāya niścalām| tāpasāśramaviśrāntairadhyātmakathanakramaiḥ|| śāstrāṇāṃ adhyātmaviṣayāṇāṃ vākyārthe ātmādvaitalakṣaṇe yathāvanniścalāṃ matimādhāya tāpasāśrameṣu viśrāntairadhyātmaniṣṭhaiḥ saha adhyātmakathanakramaiḥ|| saṃsāranindakaistadvadvairāgyakathanakramaiḥ| śilāśāyyāsanāsīno jarayatyāyurātatam|| saṃsāranindakairvairāgyakathanaiśca śilāyāmeva śayyāyāṃ yatraivāsana evāsīnaḥ sannātatamāyurjarayati kṣapayati|| vanāvanivihāreṇa cittopaśamaśobhinā| asaṅgasukhasaukhyena kālaṃ nayati nītimān|| vyutthānadaśāyāṃ vanāvanivihāreṇa samādhau punaścittopaśamaśobhinā asaṅgasukhasaukhyena śabdādisaṅgasukhādanyat yatsaukhyaṃ tena avidyamānaṃ saṅgasukhaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ ātmārāmāṇāṃ yatsaukhyaṃ teneti vā svarūpasukhamucyate| tena ca kālaṃ jīvitakālaṃ nayati|| abhyāsātsādhustrāṇāṃ karaṇātpuṇyakarmaṇām| jantoryathāvadeveyaṃ vastudṛṣṭiḥ prasīdati|| iyaṃ vastudṛṣṭiḥ asaṃsaṅgābhidhāyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ yā jñānakakṣā seyamityarthaḥ|| tṛtīyāṃ bhūmikāṃ prāpya buddho'nubhavati svayam| dviṣakāramasaṃsaṅgaṃ tasya bhedamimaṃ śṛṇu|| tatraivāvātantarabhedanirūpaṇāyāha -- tṛtīyāmiti|| tṛtīyāṃ bhūmikāṃ prāpya buddho jñānī sāmānyaṃ śreṣṭhameva ca dviprakāramasaṃsaṅgamanubhavati|| dvividho'yamasaṃsaṅgaḥ sāmānyaḥ śreṣṭha eva ca| nāhaṃ bhoktā na kartā ca na bādhyo na ca bādhakaḥ|| neti|| ahaṃ kartā na niṣkriyatvāt| bhoktā ca na nityatṛptatvāt| bādhakaśca na nirvyāpāratvāt|| ityasañjanamartheṣu sāmānyāsaṅganāmakam|| ityevamartheṣu yadasañjanaṃ saṅgarāhityaṃ tatsāmānyāsaṅganāmakam|| prākkarmanirmitaṃ sarvamīśvarādhīnameva vā| sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ kaivātra mama kartṛtā|| etadeva prapañcayati -- prāgiti ślokatrayaṃ vākyam|| sukhaṃ vā duḥkhaṃ vā sarvaṃ nirīśvaravāde prākkarmanirmitam| seśvaravāde tu īśvarādhīnameva| atrāsminpakṣadvaye'pi mama kaiva kartṛtā| na kācidityarthaḥ|| bhogābhogā mahārogāḥ saṃpadaḥ paramāpadaḥ| viyogāyaiva saṃyogā ādhayo vyādhayo dhiyaḥ|| bhogābhogāḥ viṣayavistārāḥ mahārogāḥ paryantaparitāpitvāt saṃpadaḥ samṛddhayaḥ paramāpadaḥ arjanarakṣaṇādinimittaduḥkhahetutvāt| ādhayaścintā dhiyo vyādhayaḥ buddhikleśahetutvāt|| kālaḥ kavalanodyuktaḥ sarvabhāvānvināśayan| tiṣṭhatīti vicāro yaḥ sāmānyo'sāvasaṃgamaḥ|| kālaśca kavalanodyuktaḥ saṃhārodyataḥ sansarvabhāvānvināśayan tiṣṭhatīti yo vicāraḥ asau sāmānyāsaṃgamaḥ|| anena kramayogena saṃyogena mahātmanām| viyogenāsatāmantaḥ prayogeṇātmasaṃvidām|| śreṣṭhamasaṅgamāha -- aneneti ślokacatuṣṭayaṃ vākyam|| anena pūrvoktamayogena abhyāsayogena mahātmanāṃ saṃyogena asatāṃ durjanānāṃ viyogena varjanena ātmasaṃvidāṃ ātmavicārāṇāṃ prayogeṇa ca|| ṣauruṣeṇa prayatnena saṃtatābhyāsayogataḥ| karāmalakavadvastunyāgate sphuṭatāṃ dṛḍham|| pauruṣema prayatnena yaḥ saṃtatābhyāsaḥ samādhyabhyāsaḥ tadyogataḥ karāmalakavadvastuni sphuṭatāmāgate sati|| nāhaṃ karteśvaraḥ kartā karma vā prāktanaṃ mama| kṛtvā dūratare nūnamiti śabdārthabhāvanām|| nāhaṃ kartā īśvaraḥ prāktanaṃ vā karmaiva karteti śabdārthabhāvanāṃ śabdārthānusaṃdhānaṃ dūratare'tyantadūre kṛtvā tyaktvā|| saṃsārāmbunidheḥ pāre sāre paramākāraṇe| yanmaunamāsanaṃ śāntaṃ tacchreṣṭhāsaṅga ucyate|| paramakāraṇe sarvakāraṇe sāre abādhite saṃsārāmbunidheḥ pāre prapañcātīte pare brahmaṇi pare brahmaṇi maunaṃ śāntaṃ ca yadāsanaṃ tacchreṣṭhāsaṅga ucyate|| yannāntarna bahirnādho nordhvaṃ nāśāsu nāmbare| na padārthe nāpadārthe na jaḍe na ca cetane|| tadeva viśinaṣṭi -- yaditi śvalokadvayaṃ vākyam|| yadbhāsanarūpamāśritamantarādibhiḥ deśaviśeṣairbhāvābhāvarūpaiḥ jaḍājaḍarūpairvastubhirna paricchidyate|| āśritaṃ bhāsanaṃ śāntamabhāsanamabhāvanam| anādyantamajaṃ kāntaṃ tacchreṣṭhāsaṅga ucyate|| abhāsanaṃ avidyamānaṃ svavyatiriktaṃ bhāsanaṃ prakāśakaṃ yasya| abhāvanaṃ avidyāmānaṃ bhāvanaṃ svavyatiriktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasya tādṛśaṃ sarvaprakāśakaṃ sarvakāraṇaṃ ca anādyantamajaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ ca tattādṛśaṃ bhāsanarūpamāśritaṃ śreṣṭhāsaṅga ucyate|| saṃtoṣāmodamadhuraḥ satkāryamalapallavaḥ| cittanālāgrasaṃlīno vighnakaṇṭakasaṃkaṭaḥ|| asyāstṛtīyabhūmikāyā hetumāha -- saṃtoṣeti ślokadvayaṃ vākyam|| saṃtoṣāmodamadhuraḥ alaṃbuddhiḥ saṃtoṣaḥ tajjanyenāmodena harṣeṇa madhuraḥ makarandavān| satkāryāṇyevāmalāni pallavāni patrāṇi yasya saḥ| cittameva nālaḥ tasyāgre saṃllīnaḥ vighraireva kaṇṭakaiḥ saṃkaṭaḥ saṃkīrmaḥ|| vivekapadmāṃ rūḍho'ntarvivekārkavikāsitaḥ| phalaṃ phalatyasaṃsaṅgāṃ tṛtīyāṃ bhūmikāmimām|| antarhṛdaye rūḍho vivekarūpeṇārkeṇa vikāsitaḥ san vivekapadmāṃ asaṃsaṅgāṃ tṛtīyāmimāṃ bhūmikāmeva phalaṃ phalati|| samavāyādviśuddhānāṃ saṃcayātpuṇyakarmaṇām| kākatālīyayogena prathamodeti bhūmikā|| idānīṃ prathamabhūmikāyā hetumāha -- samavāyāditi|| viśuddhānāṃ niṣkalmaṣāṇāṃ sajjanānāṃ samavāyāt puṇyakarmaṇāṃ saṃcayācca kākatālīyayogena daivagatyā prathamā bhūmikodeti|| bhūmiḥ proditamātrāntaramṛtaṅkurikeva sā| vivekenāmbusekena rakṣyā pālyā prayatnataḥ|| bhūmiriti|| sā prathamā bhūmiramṛtāṅkurikeva proditamātrāpi vivekena vivekarūpeṇāmbusekena prayatnataḥ pālyā lakṣyā ca|| yenāṃśenollasatyeṣā vicāreṇodayaṃ nayet| tamevānudinaṃ yatnātkṛṣīvala ivāṅkuram|| yeneti|| eṣā bhūmikā yenāṃśenollasati tamevāṃśaṃ vicārema yatnādanudinaṃ kṛṣīvalo'ṅkuramivodayaṃ nayet|| eṣā hi parimṛṣṭāntaranyāsāṃ prasavaikabhūḥ| dvitīyāṃ bhūmikāṃ yatnāttṛtīyāṃ prāpnuyāttataḥ|| eṣeti|| eṣā bhūmikā antaḥparimṛṣṭā vicāreṇodayaṃ nītā satī anyāsāṃ bhūmikānāṃ prasavaikabhūḥ| tatastasyā eva bhūmikāyā hetordvitīyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ ca bhūmikāṃ prāpnuyāt|| śreṣṭhāsaṃsaṅgatā hyeṣā tṛtīyā bhūmikātra hi| bhavati projjhitāśeṣasaṃkalpakalanaḥ pumān|| śreṣṭheti|| yaiṣā śreṣṭhā asaṃsaṅgatā tṛtīyā bhūmikāsti atra asyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ vartamānaḥ pumān projjhitāśeṣasaṃkalpakalano bhavati|| rāma uvāca|| mūḍhasyāsatkulotthasya pravṛttasyādhamasya ca| aprāptayogasaṅgasya kathamuttaraṇaṃ bhavet|| mūḍhasyeti|| mūḍhasya ajñasya pravṛttasya kāmyakarmaniṣṭhasya|| ekāmatha dvitīyāṃ vā tṛtīyāṃ vaitarāṃ ca vā| ārūḍhasya mṛtasyātha kīdṛsī bhagavangatiḥ|| ekāmiti|| dvitīyāṃ tṛtīyāmitarāṃ ca vā ekāṃ bhūmikāmārūḍhasya athānantaraṃ mṛtasya kīdṛśī gatiḥ|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| mūḍhasyārūḍhadoṣasya tāvatsaṃsṛtirātatā| yāvajjanmāntaraśatairnoditā prathamātra bhūḥ|| prathamapraśnasyottaraṃ ślokatrayeṇāha -- mūḍhasyeti|| ārūḍhadoṣasya pravṛddharāgādidoṣasya mūḍhasya janmāntaraśatairapi yāvatprathamā bhūmikā noditā tāvatsaṃsṛtirevātatā bhavati|| athavā sādhusaṃgatyā kākatālīyayogataḥ| saṃsārasya parāmarśīdvairāgyaṃ samudeti hi|| athavā kākatālīyayogataḥ sādhusaṃgatyā saṃsārasya parāmarśāddoṣadarnanādvairāgyodaye|| vairāgye'bhyudite jantoravaśyaṃ bhūmikodayaḥ| tato naśyati saṃsāra iti śāstrārthasaṃgrahaḥ|| bhūmikodayātsaṃsāro naśyatīti śāstrārthasaṃgrahaḥ|| yogabhūmikayotkrāntajīvitasya śarīriṇaḥ| bhūmikāṃśānusāreṇa kṣīyate pūrvaduṣkṛtam|| dvitīyapraśnasyottaraṃ ślokapañcakenāha -- yogeti|| yogabhūmikayā prathamādiṣvanyatamayotkrāntajīvitasya mṛtasya śarīriṇo jīvasya bhūmikāṃśānusāreṇa bhūmikāprakarṣānusāreṇaiva pūrvaduṣkṛtaṃ kṣīyate|| tataḥ suravimāneṣu lokapālapureṣu ca| meruparvatakuñjeṣu ramate ramaṇīsakhaḥ|| tataḥ sukṛtamahimnā suravimānādiṣu svargapradeśeṣu ramaṇīsakho ramate|| tataḥ sukṛtasaṃbhāre duṣkṛte ca purā kṛte| bhogakṣayātparikṣīṇe jāyante yogino bhuvi|| tataḥ purā kṛte sukṛtasaṃbhāre duṣkṛte ca bhogakṣayāt kṣayahetorbhūmikāṃśācca parikṣīṇe sati bhuvi|| śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe gupte gumavatāṃ satām| janitvā yogamevaite sevante yogavāsitāḥ|| śucīnāṃ guṇavatāṃ śrīmatāṃ satāṃ gupte surakṣite gehe yogino jāyante| janitvā caite yogavāsitatvāt yogameva sevante|| tatra prāgbhāvanābhyastaṃ yogabhūmikramaṃ budhāḥ| dṛṣṭvoparipatantyuccairuttaraṃ bhūmikākramam|| tatra ca prāgbhāvanābhyastaṃ yogabhimikākramaṃ dṛṣṭvā uttaraṃ bhūmikākramaṃ paripatanti abhyasanti|| bhūmikātritayaṃ tvetadrāma jāgraditi smṛtam| jāgratīvātra vispaṣṭaṃ bhedabuddhyanuvartanāt|| bhūmiketi|| etatpūrvoktaṃ bhūmikātritayaṃ jāgraditi smṛtam| kutaḥ atra asyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ jāgratīva vispaṣṭaṃ bhedabuddhyanuvartanāt|| udeti yogayuktānāmatra kevalamāryatā| yāṃ dṛṣṭvā mūḍhabuddhīnāmapyudeti mumukṣutā|| udetīti|| atra bhūmikātraye yogayuktānāṃ pūrvamāryatā kevalamudeti yāmāryatāṃ dṛṣṭvā mūḍhabuddhīnāmapi mumukṣutodeti|| kartavyamācarankāmamakartavyamanācaran| tiṣṭhati prakṛtācāro yaḥ sa ārya iti smṛtaḥ|| yathācāraṃ yathācittaṃ yathāśāstraṃ yathāsthitam| vyavahāramupādatte yaḥ sa ārya iti smṛtaḥ|| āryalakṣaṇaṃ ślokadvayenāha -- kartavyamiti|| prakṛtācāraḥ prakṛtamāvaśyakaṃ dehadhāraṇopayuktamācaran yathāsthitaṃ sthitirmaryādā tadanatikramya prathamāyāmaṅkuritaṃ bhūmau vikasitaṃ tataḥ| dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ phalatyāryatvamuttamam|| āryatāyāṃ mṛto yogī śuddhasaṃkalpasaṃbhṛtān| bhogānbhuktvā ciraṃ kālaṃ yogavāñjāyate punaḥ|| prathamāyāmiti|| āryatvaṃ prathamāyāṃ bhūmāvaṅkurītaṃ bhavati| tato dvitīyāyāṃ vikasitaṃ sat tṛtīyāyāṃ phalati|| bhūmikātritayābhyāsādajñāne kṣayamāgate| samyagjñānodaye citte pūrṇacandrodayopame|| bhūmiketi ślokadvayaṃ vākyam| pūrvoktabhūmikātritayābhyāsāt ajñāne kṣayamāgate samyagjñānodaye ca sati citte pūrṇacandrodayopame sati|| nirvibhāgamanādyante yogino yuktacetasaḥ| samaṃ sarvaṃ prapaśyanti caturthīṃ bhūmikāṃ gatāḥ|| anādyante vastuni yuktacetasaḥ caturthī bhūmikāṃ gatā yoginaḥ sarvaṃ jagannirvibhāgaṃ samaṃ prapaśyanti|| advaite sthairyamāyāte dvaite praśamamāgate| paśyanti svapnavallokaṃ caturthīṃ bhūmikāmitāḥ|| advaita iti|| itāḥ prāptāḥ|| bhūmikātritayaṃ jāgraccaturthī svapna ucyate| cittaṃ tu śaradabhrāṃśavilāyaṃ pravilīyate|| bhūmiketi|| caturthī bhūmikā svapna ucyate| yasmāttasyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ cittaṃ śaradabhrāṃśavilāyaṃ pravilīyate| śaradabhrāṃśavatpravilīyata ityarthaḥ|| sattāvaśeṣa evāste pañcamīṃ bhūmikāṃ gataḥ| jagadvikalpo nodeti cittasyātra vilāpanāt|| satteti|| pañcamīṃ bhūmikāṃ gato yogī sattāvaseṣa evāste sanmātrarūpa evāste| yasmātkāraṇādatra bhūmikāyāṃ cittasya vilāpanāt jagadvikalpo nodeti|| pañcamīṃ bhūmikāmetya suṣuptapadanāmikām| śāntāśeṣaviśeṣāṃśastiṣṭhatyadvaitamātrake|| pañcamīmiti|| suṣuptapadanāmikāṃ pañcamīṃ bhūmikāmāsādya śāntāśeṣaviśeṣāṃśaḥ advaitamātre tiṣṭhati|| galitadvaitanirbhāso mudito'ntaḥ prabodhavān| suṣuptaghana evāste pañcamīṃ bhūmikāṃ gataḥ|| galiteti|| pañcamīṃ bhūmikāṃ gato yogī galitadvaitanirbhāso mudito'ntaḥ prabodhavān suṣuptaghana evāste suṣuptavaddhanībhūya evāste|| antarmukhatayā tiṣṭhanbahirvṛttiparo'pi san| pariśāntatayā nityaṃ nidrāluriva lakṣyate|| antariti|| atra bahirvṛttiparaḥ sannapi antarmukhatayā tiṣṭhanpariśāntatayā nidrāluriva nityaṃ lakṣyate|| kurvannabhyāsametasyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ vivāsanaḥ| ṣaṣṭhīṃ turyābhidhāmanyāṃ kramātpatati bhūmikām|| kurvanniti|| etasyāṃ pañcamyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ abhyāsaṃ kurvan kramādvivāsanasturyābhidhāṃ ṣaṣṭhīmanyāṃ bhūmikāṃ patati|| yātrānāsannasadrūpo nāhaṃ nāpyanahaṃkṛtiḥ| kevalaṃ kṣīṇamanana āste dvaitaikyanirgataḥ|| ṣaṣṭhabhūmikāṃ prāptasya svarūpamāha -- yatreti ślokatrayaṃ vākyam|| yatra yasyāṃ ṣaṣṭhabhūmikāyāṃ vartamāno yogī asat asadrūpo na vyavahartṛtvāt| sadrūpaśca na nirvāsanatvāt| ahaṃ na ahamityabhimānābhāvāt| anahaṃkṛtiśca na dehendriyādipravartakatvāt kiṃ tarhi kevalaṃ kṣīṇamananatvāt nirvikalpatvāt| dvaitaikyanirgataḥ bhedābhedābhyāṃ nirgato vyapadeśya āste|| nirgranthiḥ śāntasaṃdeho jīvanmukto vibhāvanaḥ| anirvāṇo'pi nirvāṇaścitradīpa iva sthitaḥ|| kiṃca nirgranthiḥ ahaṃkārasya granthirūpasya vicchinnatvāt| śāntasaṃdeho vibhāvano vigatavāsanaśca jīvanmukto yogī anirvāṇo'pi dehaṃ dhārayannapi nirvāṇaḥ nirahaṃkāratvāt nirvāsanatvācca citradīpa iva ālekhyagatapradīpa iva sthitaḥ|| antaḥśūnyo bahiḥśūnyaḥ śūnyakumbha ivāmbare| antaḥpūrṇo bahiḥpūrṇaḥ pūrṇakumbha ivārṇave|| antariti|| kiṃca prapañcadṛṣṭayā antaḥśūnyo nirvāsanatvāt| bahiḥśūnyo bahirapi brahmaivedaṃ sarvamityanusaṃdhānāttathāca ambare vartamānaḥ śūnyakumbha iva rikto ghaṭa iva bhavati| kiṃca brahmadṛṣṭyā antaḥpūrṇaḥ sarvadāntarbhāvanāt| bahiśca pūrṇo bahirapi brahmabhāvanāt| tathācārṇave vartamānaḥ pūrṇakumbha iva ca bhavati|| kiṃcidevaiṣa saṃpannastvathavaiṣa na kiṃcana| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhūmyāmasau sthitvā saptamīṃ bhūmimāpnuyāt|| kiṃciditi|| eṣa ṣṭhabhūmigato yogī kiṃcideva vastusaṃpanno jātaḥ sadrūpatvāt| athavā eṣa na kiṃcana saṃpannaḥ avyapadeśyatvāt| itthaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhūmau sthitvā asau yogī saptamīṃ bhūmikāmāpnuyāt|| videhamuktatā tūktā saptamī yogabhūmikā| agamyā vacasāṃ śāntā sā sīmā bhavabhūmiṣu|| videheti ślokacatuṣṭayaṃ vākyam| saptamī yogabhūmikā tu videhamuktatoktā śāntā vacasāṃ agamyā ca sā bhavabhūmikā tu videhamuktatoktā śāntā vacasāṃ agamyā ca sā bhavabhūmikā sīmā avadhiḥ| itaḥ paraṃ bhūmikāntarasyābhāvāt|| kaiścitsā śiva ityuktā kaiścidbrahmetyudāhṛtā| kaiścidviṣṇuriti proktā kaiścicchūnyamiti smṛtā|| artha ityuditā kaiścitkaiścitkāla iti smṛtā| kaiścitprakṛtipuṃbhāvavibhāga iti bhāvitā|| anyairapyanyathā nānābhedairātmavikalpitaiḥ| nityamavyapadeśyāpi kathaṃcidvyapadiśyate|| sā ca nirupādhikatvānnityamavyapadeśyāpi tattanmatabhedena taistairvādibhiḥ śivādiśabdaiḥ kathaṃcitkalpitopādhinā vyapadiśyate|| spataitā bhūmikāḥ proktā mayā tava raghūdvaha| āsāmabhyāsayogena na duḥkhamanubhūyate|| atra ca saptānāṃ yogabhūmikānāṃ nāmāni lakṣaṇāni ca pūrvamuktatvānnoktāni tattadbhūmikāvatāṃ cihnānyeva tu pūrvamanuktatvādiha pṛṣṭāni prapañcitāni ca yaccātra noktaṃ nāmādikaṃ tadutpattiprakaraṇe lavaṇākhyāne draṣṭavyam|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| astyanantamadonmattā mṛdumantharacāriṇī| kariṇīvigrahavyagrā mahādaśanaśaṅkhinī|| mā cennihanyate nūnamanantānarthakāriṇī| tadaitāsu samagrāsu bhūmikāsu naro'jayī|| astīti|| kariṇī nāma icchā tasyāśca mado vāsanāvyūhaḥ mahādaśanau dharmādharmāvityādirāmapraśnānantaraṃ vasiṣṭha eva spaṣṭīkariṣyati mahādaśanābhyāmeva śaṅkhinī śaṅkhavatī kariṇīti|| kariṇī madamattā sā yāvanna vijitaujasā| ko nāma subhaṭastāvatsaṃpatsamarabhūmiṣu|| rāma uvāca|| kāsau pramātta kariṇī kāśca tā raṇabhūmayaḥ| kathaṃ nihanyate caiṣā kva caiṣā ramate ciram|| saṃpatsamarabhūmiṣu saṃsārasaṃpada eva samarabhūmayaḥ saṃsārasaṃpado rāma tasyāḥ samarabhūmaya iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| rāmecchā nāma kariṇī sedaṃ me'stviti rūpiṇī| śarīrakānane mattā vividhollāsakāriṇī|| rāmeti ślokadvayaṃ vākyam|| kariṇī nāma icchā sā ca icchā idaṃ me astvityevaṃrūpiṇī sā cecchārūpā kariṇī śarīra eva kānane mattā satī vividhollāsakaraṇaśīlā|| mattendriyograkalabhā rasanākalabhāṣiṇī| manogahanasaṃlīnā karmadantadvayānvitā|| mattānīndriyāṇyevogrāḥ kalabhā yasyāstādṛśī| rasanākalabhāṣiṇī rasanaiva rasanā tadīyā tayā kalabhāṣaṇaśīlā| mana eva gahanaṃ duḥpraveśasthānaṃ tatra saṃlīnā| karmadantadvayānvitā puṇyāpuṇyalakṣamadaśanadvayavatī|| mado'syā vāsanāvyūhaḥ sarvataḥ prasaradvapuḥ| icchānāgī nihantyeṣā kṛpaṇāñjīvasaṃcayān|| mada iti|| asyāḥ khecchākāriṇyāḥ sarvataḥ prasaradvapuḥ vāsanāvyūha eva madaḥ eṣā cecchānāgī kṛpaṇāneva jīvasaṃcayānnihanti|| saṃsāradṛṣṭayo rāma tasyāḥ samarabhūmayaḥ| bhūyo yatrānubhavati narojayaparājayau|| saṃsāreti|| naraḥ pumān jayaparājayau bhūyo yatrānubhavati tāḥ saṃsāradṛṣṭya eva tasyāḥ samarabhūmayaḥ|| vāsanehā manaścittaṃ saṃkalpo bhāvanaṃ spṛhā| ityādirnivaho nāmnāmasyā āśayakośagaḥ|| vāsaneti|| āśayakośagaḥ āśayo'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ sa eva kośaḥ kośagṛhaṃ tadgataḥ tadviṣayo yo vāsanā īhā manaścittaṃ saṃkalpo bhāvanaṃ spṛhetyādiḥ śabdasamudāyaḥ so'syā icchākariṇyā nāmnāṃ nivahaḥ| ityādīti napuṃsakaliṅgapāṭhe vāsanetyādipadakadambakaṃ āśayakośago'syāḥ kariṇyā nāmnāṃ nivaha iti yojanīyam|| dhairyanāmnā varāstreṇa prasṛtāmavahelayā| nāgīṃ sarvātmikāmetāmicchāṃ sarvātmanā jayet|| dhairyeti|| avahelayā itareṣāṃ sarveṣāmastrāṇāṃ avajñayā prasṛtāṃ sarvātmikāṃ sarvaviṣayatvādviṣayaistādātmyāpannāṃ icchārūpāṃ nāgīṃ dhairyanāmnā varāstreṇa sarvātmanā sarvaprakāreṇāpi jayet| dhairyaṇaivāṅkuśenecchārūpāṃ nāgīṃ kariṇīṃ vaśīkuryādityarthaḥ| dhairyaṃ cātra pare brahmaṇi cittasya sthairyam|| yāvadastvidamityevamiyamantarvijṛmbhate| tāvadugrā kusaṃsāramahāviṣaviṣūcikā|| yāvaditi|| idamastvityevaṃrūpā iyamicchākariṇī yāvadantarvijṛmbhate tāvadeveyamugra kusaṃsāramahāviṣaviṣūcikā vijṛmbhate| kutsitaḥ saṃsāra eva mahatī viṣajanyā viṣūcikā|| etāvāneva saṃsāra idamastviti yanmanaḥ| asya tūpaśamo mokṣa ityevaṃ jñānasaṃgrahaḥ|| etāvāneveti|| idamastviti yanmanaḥsaṃkalpanamastyetāvāneva saṃsāraḥ| sarvasyāpi saṃsāsya manomūlatvāt asya tu manasa upasama eva mokṣaḥ| ityevaṃ jñānasya jñānopadeśasya saṃgraḥ saṃkṣepaḥ|| prasādakāriṇī svacchā niricche vimalākṛtau| tailabindurivādarśe viśrāmyatyupadeśavāk|| prasādeti|| svacchā svayaṃ nirmalā ataśca prasādakāriṇī paracittaprasādaheturupadeśavāk paropadeśaparaguruvākyaṃ niricche niḥsaṃkalpe ataśca vimalākṛtau śiṣye ādarśe darpaṇe tailabinduriva viśrāmyati saṃkrāmati| tailabindurapi prasādahetuḥ svacchaśca| darpaṇo'pi niriccho vimalākṛtiśca|| manāgapyuditaivecchā chettavyānarthakāriṇī| asaṃvedanaśastreṇa viṣasyevāṅkurāvalī|| manāgiti|| anarthakāriṇī iyamicchā manāgapi uditaiva viṣasya viṣavṛkṣasya aṅkurāvalīva asaṃvedanaśastreṇa saṃvedanaṃ bāhyānusaṃdhānaṃ tadabhāvo'saṃvedanaṃ tenaiva śastreṇa chettavyā|| icchāvicchurito jīvo vijahāti na dīnatām| asaṃvedanamātreṇa nodetīcchābhavāṅkuraḥ|| iccheti|| jīvaḥ icchayā vicchuritaḥ san dīnatāṃ iṣṭārthasiddhinimittaṃ dainyaṃ na vijahāti| bhavāṅkura icchā ca asaṃvedanamātreṇa nodeti|| asaṃvedanaśastraṃ tu tūṣṇīṃ cittavyavasthitiḥ| pratyāhāraḥ sa vijñeyastenecchā vinivāryate|| kiṃ tadasaṃvedanamityatrāha -- asaṃvedaneti|| cittasya tūṣṇīṃ vyavasthitirevāsaṃvedanaśastraṃ sa eva ca pratyāhārarūpaṃ yogāṃgaṃ tenaivecchā nivāryate|| idaṃ mestviti vijñānamāhuḥ kalpanamuttamāḥ| arthasyābhāvanaṃ yattatkalpanātyāga ucyate|| idamiti|| idaṃ mestviti vijñānameva kalpanamāhuḥ| arthasya bāhyasya yadabhāvanaṃ tadeva kalpanātyāga ucyate|| smaraṇaṃ viddhi saṃkalpaṃ śivamasmaraṇaṃ viduḥ| tatra prāganubhūtaṃ ca nānubhūtaṃ ca bhāvyate|| smaraṇamiti|| smaraṇameva saṃkalpaṃ viddhi| asmaraṇaṃ ca śivaṃ śāntaṃ brahma viduḥ| tatra ca smaraṇe prāganubhūtaṃ nānubhūtaṃ ca vastu bhāvyate viṣayīkriyate|| anubhūtāṃ nānubhūtāṃ smṛtiṃ vismṛtya kāṣṭhavat| sarvamevāśu vismṛtya mūḍhastiṣṭha mahāmatiḥ|| anubhūtāmiti|| anubhūtāṃ nānubhūtāṃ anubhūtaviṣayāmananubhūtaviṣayāṃ ca smṛtiṃ vismṛtya vihāya kāṣṭhavatsarvameva vismṛtya ananusaṃdhāya mahāmatireva san mūḍhastiṣṭha mūḍhavattiṣṭha|| ūrdhvabāhurviraumyeṣa na ca kaścicchṛṇoti tat| asaṃkalpaḥ paraṃ śreyaḥ sa kimantarna bhāvyate|| ūrdhvabāhuriti|| ūrdhvabāhuḥ sarveṣāṃ prabodhāya uddhṛtabhujaḥ sanneṣo'haṃ paramārthadarśī viraumi ghoṣayāmi| atra na kaścidapi śṛṇoti| aho mohamahimeti śeṣaḥ| kiṃ tadvirāvyamityatrāha -- asaṃkalpa iti| asaṃkalpa eva paraṃ śreyaḥ so'yaṃ kimityantaḥ sarvairapi mumukṣubhirna bhāvyate|| kila tūṣṇīṃsthitenaiva tatpadaṃ prāpyate param| paramaṃ yatra sāmrājyamapi rāma tṛṇāyate|| kileti|| paramaṃ sāmrājyamapi yatra yasminpade bhāvyamāne tṛṇāyate tṛṇamiva tucchaṃ bhāti tatparaṃ padaṃ tūṣṇīṃsthitenaiva kila prāpyate| aho saulabhyaṃ paramapadasyeti śeṣaḥ|| gamyadeśaikaniṣṭhasya yathā pānthasya pādayoḥ| spando vigatasaṃkalpastathā spandaḥ svakarmasu|| bahunātra kimuktena saṃkṣepādidamucyate| saṃkalpanaṃ paro bandhastadabhāvo vimuktatā|| gamyeti|| gamyadeśaikaniṣṭhasya gantavyadeśatatparasya pānthasya pādayoḥ spandaḥ saṃcāro yathā vigatasaṃkalpaḥ pratipadaṃ saṃkalpābhāvāt tathā jñānino brahmaniṣṭhasya svakarmasu spando vyavahāro vigatasaṃkalpaḥ|| sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ śāntamanantaṃ dhruvamavyayam| paśyanbhūtārthacidrūpaṃ śānta āsva yathāsukham|| sarvamiti|| sarvamidaṃ jagat śāntādilakṣaṇaṃ bhūtārthacidrūpaṃ paramārthacinmayaṃ paśyan śānto yathāsukhamāsva|| avedanaṃ viduryogaṃ śāntamāsanamuttamam| yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi vikarmāṇyatha mā kuru|| avedanamiti|| śāntaṃ nirvikāraṃ uttamamāsanameva avedanayogaṃ nirvikalpasamādhiṃ viduḥ| ataścaya tvaṃ yogasthaḥ siddhyasiddhyoḥ samatvaṃ yogaḥ tanniṣṭhaḥ karmāṇi kuru| nīraso niṣkāmo vā kuru| athavā ātmārāmatayā kartavyābhāvānmā kuru|| avedanaṃ viduryogaṃ cittakṣayamakṛtrimam| atyantaṃ tanmayo bhūtvā tathā tiṣṭha yathāsi bhoḥ|| avedanamiti|| avedanameva yogaṃ akṛtrimaṃ aprayāsasiddhaṃ cittakṣayaṃ ca viduḥ| ataścātyantaṃ tanmayo bhūtvā yathāsi yadrūpo'si tathā tiṣṭha|| ahaṃmameti saṃvidanna duḥkhato vimucyase| asaṃvidanvimucyase yadīpsitaṃ tadācara|| ahamiti|| tvaṃ ahaṃ mameti ca saṃvidan abhimanyamāno duḥkhato duḥkhamayātsaṃsārānna vimucyase| itthamasaṃvidaṃstu vimucyase| atra bandhamokṣasādhanadvaye yadīpsitamabhimataṃ tadācareti nipuṇoktiḥ|| śivaṃ sargagataṃ śāntaṃ bodhātmakamajaṃ śubham| tadekabhāvanaṃ rāma karmatyāga iti smṛtaḥ|| iti śrīyogavāsiṣṭhasāre nirvāmaprakaraṇe yogasaptabhūmikopākhyānaṃ nāma pañcadaśaḥ sargaḥ || 15 || prakṛtopasaṃhāravyājena mahāta prabandhenopapāditamātmādvaitavijñānamupasaṃharannāha -- śivamiti|| yatkhalu śivaṃ brahma sargagataṃ paripūrṇaṃ śāntaṃ nirvikāraṃ ajaṃ janmādirahitaṃ śubhaṃ aśubhasaṃsāranivartakaṃ bodhātmakaṃ viśuddhajñānātmakaṃ tadekabhāvanaṃ tasyaiva brahmaṇa ekamadvaitaṃ yadbhāvanaṃ brahmaivedaṃ sarvamiti yatparipūrṇaṃ bhāvanaṃ tadeva jīrṇaparṇavat karmaṇāṃ kuṭṭanahetutvātkarmatyāga iti smṛtaḥ iti vidhīyamānakarmatyāgarūpāpekṣayā puṃlliṅganirdeśaḥ| asaṃvedanamasaṃkalpanaṃ tūṣṇīṃbhāva iti yannaiṣkarmyaṃ karma prakṛtaṃ tasyāyamupasaṃhāra iti sarvaṃ samañjasam|| iti saṃsārataraṇināmni yogavāsiṣṭhavivaraṇe nirvāṇaprakaraṇe saptabhūmikopākhyānaṃ nāma pañcadaśaḥ sargaḥ|| 15 || <6.16> śāstragrahaṇaphalanirdeśaḥ|| ṣoḍaśaḥ sargaḥ|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| prasadya vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yatkaṭākhyārasāñjanam| vādī vāggmī kaviścāyaṃ rāma kīrtiṃ sṛjatyaho|| nindanti ye hariharāryakṛpāmṛtābdhiṃ svacchandasaṃcaraṇasaṃcitavāñchitārthāḥ| nindanti te jalanidhiṃ bahirutkṣipante snātuṃ samāgatavato'pi taraṅgahastaiḥ|| majjantamapyanudinaṃ dvijarājamekamadyāpi naiva jaladhirvimalīkaroti| spaṣṭo'pyaho hariharāryakṛpāmbudhiste prakṣālayatyamatipaṅkamapi dvijānām|| manyāmahe hariharārthaguro tvadīyavāṇīsudhājaladhimeva varaṃ vareṇyam| ānandakandalitanandanapārijātaniṣyandamānamakarandamahīnadīnām|| vālmīkiruvāca|| ityuktatyatha munau divaso jagāma snātuṃ samākṛtamunipraṇatirjagāma| sāyaṃtanāstavidhaye'stamito jagāma śyāmākṣaye ravikaraiśca sabhā jagāma|| aṣṭādaśeti divasānvidadhe gariṣṭhāṃ goṣṭhīṃ vasiṣṭhamuninā saha rāmacandraḥ| hitvā bhavaprabhavamohamathāvatasthe nirvātavāridhirivācalasattvapūrṇaḥ|| tasminkṣaṇe kalpataruprasūtaprasūnasaṅghasya papāta vṛṣṭiḥ| saṃtuṣṭagīrvāṇagaṇapramuktā muktāphalādabhramivābhrapūrṇā|| avatīrya svayaṃ viṣṇurmānuṣyo rāmanāmadhṛk| khinnaḥ saṃsārajāle'sminyogajñānena bodhitaḥ|| prabuddhenātha rāmeṇa saṃpūjyābhiṣṭuto muhuḥ| pitṛbhrātṛsametena praṇamyābhihito muniḥ|| tvatprasādādbho bhagavanniḥsaṃśayamidaṃ manaḥ| vijvaraṃ śītalaṃ śāntaṃ saṃjātamavikāri me|| sarvārtihartā sarvajñaḥ sarvadevāśrito guruḥ| mohāndhakāravidhvaṃsaḥ saviteva bhavāniti|| tatastadānīṃ muninā rāmāya gaganasthitāḥ| śrotumabhyāgatā devā āhūya prakaṭīkṛtāḥ|| yakṣagandharvasiddharṣividyādharamahoragāḥ| rāmeṇa praṇatāścainamūcuḥ saṃtuṣṭamānasāḥ|| śrutamasmābhirakhilaṃ jñānametanmahodayam| trailokyamohārtiharau bhavantau praṇatā vayam|| bhavadgurorvasiṣṭhasya bhavataśca mahātmanaḥ| mithaḥ saṃvādamakhilaṃ jñānametanmahodayam|| tataḥ siddhairayodhyāyāṃ stutvaitadavatāritam| kāśmīramaṇḍalasyāntarbhūtānāmanukampayā|| atha sarvāṇi kāryāṇi jñātatattvo gatavyathaḥ| nirmamo nirmame rāmo niṣkāmo janako yathā|| yatāmbu bisinīpatre sajjate nāmbumajjanaiḥ| tathāsya rājyabhogena na ceto rajyate'malam|| śāstraṃ tvidaṃ viraktā ye satsaṅgāḥ satkriyāparāḥ| teṣāṃ dharmātmanāmeva pradātavyaṃ prayatnataḥ|| sarvā sarvopakārāya matiścedasti vaḥ śubhā| tadidaṃ sarvathā deyaṃ vidyādānaṃ mahāphalam|| durgrahagrastamanasāmasādhūnāṃ pramādinām| nindakānāmidaṃ śāstraṃ rahasyaṃ na prakāśayet|| pūrvaṃ nārādhito yena bhagavāninduśekharaḥ| harirbrahmā raviścāpi na labhedidamadbhutam|| maheśvareṇa yatproktaṃ devyā yaccāpi viṣṇunā| munīnāṃ nāradādīnāṃ tadidaṃ jñānamuttamam|| mahārāmāyaṇākhyaṃ yanmokṣopāyāparābhidham| tataḥ kṣīranidhiprakhyātpīyūṣamidamuddhṛtam|| sāmānyena vicāreṇa kṣayamāyāti duṣkṛtam| samyagasya vicāreṇa ko na yāti paraṃ padam|| ekavelamadhītena śāstreṇānena kilbilam| praṇaśyati nṛṇāṃ sarvaṃ kṣipraṃ bodhaśca jāyate|| aprabuddho'pi yaścedaṃ bhāvayedbhaktibhāvitaḥ| tasya nirmalatāsiddhaṃ cittaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ|| mūḍhairmumukṣubhirvāpi saṃyatairvāpyasaṃyataiḥ| paramārthamidaṃ cintyaṃ durlabhaṃ brahmadarśanam|| kiṃcitsaṃskṛtabuddhīnāṃ śrutaṃ śāstramidaṃ yathā| saukhyāpahaṃ tathā sāstramanyadasti na kiṃcana|| bhuktimuktipradamidaṃ yogināṃ paramaṃ priyam| hastasthaṃ prāpya cidrūpaṃ prāk‌puṇyaireva labhyate|| sarvāgamārthasaṃvettā vasiṣṭhaḥ paramo mataḥ| mokṣopāyasya sāro'yamiti sarvatra gīyate|| priyārthādiviyogena jātakhedasya dehinaḥ| śāstraṃ vinā kimatra syādantaḥsaṃtāpaśantidam|| cidambarātprodita eva pūrṇaḥ śāstraṃ nurānandanidhiḥ supādaḥ| sāndrāmṛtaḥ kāvyarasopaśobhāsphuranprakāśaḥ kṣapito'ndhakāraḥ|| snātaṃ tena samastatīrthasalilaiḥ sarvāpi dattāvaniryajñānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ sahasramakhilā devāśca saṃpūjitāḥ| saṃsārācca samuddhṛtāḥ svapitarastrailokyapūjyo'pyasau yasya brahmavicāraṇe kṣaṇamapi sthairyaṃ manaḥ prāpnuyāt|| iti śrīyogavāsiṣṭhasāre nirvāmaprakaraṇe śāstragrahaṇaphalanirdeśo nāma ṣoḍaśaḥ sargaḥ|| 16 || <6.17> bharadvājānuśāsanam|| saptadaśaḥ sargaḥ|| vālmīkiruvāca|| iti varamuninoktaṃ jñānasāraṃ purāṇe sakalamanuniśamya śrīraghūṇāṃ kulāgryaḥ| vimalamatirapṛcchatkiṃcidanyatsvayaṃ vai śamasukhaparipūrṇaḥ pūrṇabodhasthito'sau|| sa khalu paramayogi viśvavandyaḥ surendro jananamaraṇahīnaḥ śuddhabodhasvarūpaḥ| sakalaguṇanidhānaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ ramāyāstrijagadudayarakṣānugrahāṇāmadhīśam|| śaktipālavaśonmeṣaprakaṭāmalaciddhanaḥ| muhūrtamāsīdudbuddhaścaitanyānandasāgaraḥ|| praśnottaravibhāgādiparipāṭīvivarjitaḥ| ānandāmṛtapūrṇāśruromakaṇṭakitāṅgakaḥ|| mahāsāmānyarūpatvacidvyāpakatayā sthitaḥ| nityamaṣṭaguṇaiśvaryatṛṇaprāyamanorathaḥ|| na kiṃcidūce saṃpannaḥ śive pariṇataḥ pade|| bharadvāja uvāca|| aho khalu mahāścaryaṃ rāmaḥ prāpto mahatpadam| kathametādṛśī prāptirasmākaṃ munināyaka|| mūrkhāḥ śocyāśca kiṃcittā mādṛśāḥ kva ca pāpinaḥ| kva ca brahmādibhiḥ prārthyā durlabhā rāma saṃsthitiḥ|| aho munīśvaraguro kathaṃ viśrāmyatāṃ mayā| duṣpāraśca bhavāmbhodhistīryate tadvadāśu me|| vālmīkiruvāca|| śrīrāmavṛttāntamaśeṣamādito vasiṣṭhavākyānugataṃ nirūpitam| dhiyā vicāryānuparāmṛśa svayaṃ mayāpi vedyaṃ kathanīyamatra te|| avidyayā prapañco'yaṃ nāsti satyamihāṇvapi| vivecayanti vibudhā vivadantyavivekinaḥ|| nāsti bhinnaṃ citaḥ kiṃcitkiṃ prapaṃcena ruddhyate| abhyāsena rahasyānāṃ vayasya viśado bhava|| prapañcaviṣayā vṛttirjāgrannidreti kīrtitā| sa prabuddhastu yasyāntaścitpradīpo nirañjanaḥ|| śūnyamūlaprapañco'yaṃ śūnyatāśikharaṃ sakhe| sāraśūnyatayā madhye'pyanāsthā sanmanīṣiṇā|| anādivāsanādoṣādasannevāyamīkṣyate| gandharvanagarākāraḥ saṃsārabahuvibhramaḥ|| citte'nabhyasya kalyāṇīṃ caitanyāmṛtakandalīm| saṃmuhyasi kimadhyāsya vāsanāviṣavīrudhaḥ|| jāgradetannipatitaṃ jñānālambagrahādadhaḥ| vasatyupari sarveṣāṃ ye nirālambasaṃvidaḥ|| tāvadūḍhasphurākārarasā vidyāmahānadī| na yāvadātmarūpeṇa nipuṇairavagāhyate|| prāṅnāsti caramaṃ nāsti vastu sarvamidaṃ sakhe| viddhi madhye'pi tannāsti svapnavṛttamidaṃ jagat|| avidyāyonayo bhedāḥ sarve'mī budbudā iva| kṣaṇamudbhūya gacchanti jñānaikajaladhau layam|| suśītalodakanadīṃ viditvā pravigāhyatām| bahirbhrāntinidāghāste niryāntu kalitāḥ śucā|| ekaścājñānajaladhirjagadātmā vyatiṣṭhati| jyeṣṭho'yamahamityūrmiravidyāvātasaṃbhavaḥ|| cittassvalanabhedālī rāgādyāśca prakalpitāḥ| mamatotkalitāvartastataḥ svairaṃ pravartate|| rāgadveṣāvatigrāhau gṛhītasamanantaram| tataścānarthapātālapraveśaḥ kena vāryate|| praśāntāmṛtakallole kevalāmṛtāvāridhau| matta majjasi kiṃ dvaitagrahakṣārābdhivīciṣuḥ|| kastiṣṭhati gataḥ ko vā kasya kena kimāgatam| kiṃ nimajjasi māyāyāmetattattvamatandritaḥ|| tattvamekaṃ yadātmeti jagadetatpracakṣate| tato'nyaḥ kastavātīto yastāta viṣayaḥ śucām|| bālānprati vivarto'yaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sakalaṃ jagat| avivartitamānandamāsthitāḥ kṛtinaḥ sadā|| avivikto janaḥ śocatyakasmācca prahṛṣyate| tattvavittu hasannāste tasya moho viḍambanam|| tacca sūkṣmamidaṃ tattvaṃ tirohitamavidyayā| yathā sthaleṣu lokānāṃ jaleṣvātmasu saṃśayaḥ|| pṛthivyādimahābhūtaparamāṇumayaṃ jagat| sthitaṃ yadā tadāpīha ko gato yo'nuśocyate|| asataḥ saṃbhavo nāsti nāstyabhāvaḥ sataḥ sakhe| āvirbhāvatirobhāvasaṃsthā nānāmayī pare|| kintvanekapurotsāhādviṣatāmupagacchati| bhaja saṃcaritābhogaṃ parameśaṃ jagadgurum|| duritāni samastāni pacyante'dyāpi na dhruvam| drutamevāsyā devasya pāśāḥ praśrayatāṃ gatāḥ|| sākāraṃ bhaja tāvattvaṃ yāvatsattvaṃ prasīdati| nirākāre pare tattve tataḥ sthitirakṛtrimā|| imamuddāmatamasaṃ jitvā śatruṃ balāddhruvam| yamasyānusara dhyānaṃ viśvastenāntarātmanā|| samādhāya kṣaṇaṃ paśya pratyagātmānamātmani| iyaṃ vibhātu saṃvyaktaṃ drāgbuddhirajanī tava|| kṛtaṃ puruṣakāreṇa kevalena ca karmaṇā| maheśānugrahādeva prāptavyaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ|| nābhijātyaṃ na cāritryaṃ na nayo na ca vikramaḥ| balavanti purāṇāni sakhe karmāṇi kevalam|| apratarkyātpratīkārātkimevamavasīdati| na lumpati lalāṭasthāmīśvaro'pyakṣamālikām|| kva cidvaktā kva vaidagdhyaṃ kva ceyaṃ mohavallarī| acintanīyā niyatirniryayeddvandvamohitam|| he bharadvāja mohaṃ tvaṃ vivekena jahi sphuṭam| asāmānyamidānīṃ te jñānaṃ prāpsyāmyasaṃśayam|| dūramutsahate rājā mahāsattvo mahāpadi| alpasattvo janaḥ śocatyalpe'pi hi parikṣaye|| bodhaṃ puṇyaparādhīnaṃ prāpyate bahujanmabhiḥ| anumīyeta dhīreṣu jīvanmukteṣu kāryataḥ|| dviṣadbhūtena yenaiva karmaṇāṃ bandha īdṛśaḥ| sṛhṛdbhūtena tenaiva mokṣamāpsyasi putraka|| satāṃ satkarmasaṃvegaḥ purāṇaṃ praṇudannayam| varṣaughaiva bhūtānāṃ dāvānalamasecayat|| sakhe saṃnyasya karmāṇi brahmaṇaḥ praṇayī bhava| neṣyate yadi saṃsāracakrāvartabhramabhramam|| tāvadetadvikalpotthamidaṃ yāvadbahirgrahaḥ| pratikūle'bdhikallole kevalaṃ niścalaṃ payaḥ|| ayaṃ kimandhaṃkaraṇastvayā śoko'valokyate| nirvāhayatu saiva tvāṃ prajñāyaṣṭirabhaṅgurā|| na jātu te vigaṇyante gaṇanāṃ sugarīyasīm| ye taraṅgaistṛṇānīva hriyante harṣaśokayoḥ|| samārūḍhadaśādolāmahodarātramidaṃ jagat| krīḍyate ṣaḍvidhaiḥ prekṣyaiḥ sakhe kimiti khidyase|| sūte saṃharati kṣipraṃ punaḥ sṛjati hanti ca| jaganti bahuparyāyaiḥ kāla eva kutūhalī|| na viśeṣagrahaḥ kaścinna kaścinna ka kaścana| jantuṣvabhyavahāryeṣu prakāmyaṃ kālabhoginaḥ|| kā kathā martyapiṇḍānāṃ nimeṣāntaravāsinām| api devanikāyā ye te duḥkālasya gocarāḥ|| svayaṃ nṛtyasi kiṃ prīte vipattau vikalendriyaḥ| kṣaṇaṃ nikhinnamāsīnaḥ paśya saṃsāranāṭakam|| asyānekataraṅgasya jagataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅginaḥ| na viṣīdati manasvī bhāradvāja manāgapi|| tyaja śokamamaṅgalyaṃ maṅgalāni vicintaya| cidānandaghanasvacchamātmānaṃ ca vibhāvaya|| devadvijaguruprājñāmarasādhuṣu cetasām| sadāgamapramāṇānāṃ maheśānugraho bhavet|| iti śrīyogavāsiṣṭhasāre nirvāṇaprakaraṇe śrīvālmīkīye mokṣopāye bharadvājānuśāsanaṃ nāma saptadaśaḥ sargaḥ|| 17 || <6.18> vasiṣṭharāmacandrasaṃvādaḥ aṣṭādaśaḥ sargaḥ|| bharadvāja uvāca|| jñātaṃ tava prasādena sarvametadaśeṣataḥ| na vairāgyātparaṃ bhāgyaṃ na saṃsārātparo ripuḥ|| idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vasiṣṭhenopapāditam| jñānasāramaśeṣeṇa granthenoktaṃ yadātmanā|| vālmīkīruvāca|| bharadvāja śṛṇuṣvedaṃ mahājñānaṃ vimuktidam| yasya śravaṇamātreṇa bhavābdhau na nimajjasi|| saṃhṛtisthitisaṃbhūtabhedairyo'nekadhā sthitaḥ| eko'pi sannamastasmai saccidānandamūrtaye|| kṛte prapañcavilaye yathā tattvaṃ prakāśate| tadopāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepācchrutiśāsanāt|| śānto dāntaścoparato niṣiddhātpāpakarmaṇaḥ| viṣayendriyasaṃśloṣasukhācca śraddhayānvitaḥ|| mṛdvāsane samāsīno jitacittendriyakriyaḥ| omityuccārayettāvanmano yāvatprasīdati|| prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryādantaḥkaraṇaśuddhaye| indriyāṇyāharetpaścādviṣayebhyaḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ|| dehendriyamanobuddhikṣetrajñānāṃ ca saṃbhavaḥ| paścādbhavati tadbhāvātteṣu paścādvilāpayet|| virāji prathamaṃ sthitvā tatrātmani tataḥ param| avyākṛte sthitaḥ paścātsthite paramakāraṇe|| māṃsādipārthivaṃ bhāgaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pravilāpayet| āpyaṃ raktādikaṃ cāpsu taijasaṃ tejasi kṣipet|| vāyavyaṃ ca mahāvāyau nabhasyaṃ nabhasi kṣipet| pṛthivyādiṣu vinyasya cendriyāṇyātmayoniṣu|| śrotrādilakṣaṇopetāḥ karturbhoktuḥ prasiddhaye| dikṣu nyasyātmanaḥ śrotraṃ tvacaṃ vidyuti nikṣipet|| cakṣurādityabimbe ca jihvāmapsu vinikṣipet| prāṇaṃ vāyau vācamagnau pāṇimandre vinikṣipet|| viṣṇau tathātmanaḥ pādau pāyuṃ mitre tathaiva ca| upasthaṃ kaśyape nyasya manaścandre niveśayet|| buddhiṃ brahmaṇi saṃyacchedetāḥ karaṇadevatāḥ| indriyavyapadeśena vyādiśyantyeva devatāḥ|| śrutivākyamanusmṛtya na svataḥ prakaṭīkṛtāḥ| evaṃ nyasyātmano dehaṃ virāḍasmīti cintayet|| brahmāṇḍāntaḥ sthito yo'sāvardhanārīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ| ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tadudāhṛtam|| sa yajñasṛṣṭirūpo'sau jāgradvṛttau vyavasthitaḥ| dviguṇāṇḍādbahiḥ pṛthvī pṛthivyā dviguṇaṃ jalam|| salilāddviguṇaṃ tejastejaso dviguṇo'nilaḥ| vāyardviguṇamākāśamūrdhvamekaikaśaḥ kramāt|| vyastena ca samastena mahatā grathitaṃ jagat| kṣitiṃ cāpsu samāveśya salilaṃ cānale kṣipet|| agniṃ vāyau samāveśya vāyuṃ ca nabhasi kṣipet| nabhaśca mahadākāśe samastotpattikāraṇe|| sthitvā tasminmahāyogī liṅgamātraśarīradhṛk| vāsanābhūtasūkṣmāśca karmāvidye tathaiva ca|| daśendriyamanobuddhiretalliṅgaṃ vidurbudhāḥ| tataścāṇḍādbahirvāyau sūtrātmāsmīti cintayet|| caturmukhograke vāyau bhūtasūkṣmavyavasthitaḥ| liṅgamavyākṛte sūkṣme nyasyāvyakte ca buddhimān|| nāmarūpavinirmuktaṃ yasminsaṃtiṣṭhate jagat| tāmāhuḥ prakṛtiṃ kecinmāyāmeke pare tvaṇūn|| avidyāmapare prāhustarkavibhrāntacetasaḥ| tatra sarve layaṃ gatvā tiṣṭhantyavyaktarūpiṇaḥ|| niḥsaṃbodhā nirāsvādāḥ saṃbhavanti tataḥ punaḥ| tatsvarūpeṇa tiṣṭhanti yāvatsṛṣṭiḥ pravartate|| ānulomyātsmṛtā sṛṣṭiḥ prātilomyena saṃhṛtiḥ| ataḥ sthānatrayaṃ tyaktvā turīyaṃ padamavyayam|| dhyāyettatprāptaye liṅgaṃ pravilāpya paraṃ viśet| bhūtendriyamanobuddhivāsanākarmavāyavaḥ|| ajñānaṃ ca praviṣṭāḥ syurliṅgamavyākṛte sati| idānīṃ liṅganigaḍānmukto'haṃ sarvathā yataḥ|| cidaṃśatvātpraviṣṭo'haṃ caitanyānandasāgare| abhedātparamātmāsmi sarvopādhivivarjitaḥ|| kūṭasthaḥ kevalo vyāpī cidacicchaktimānaham| ghaṭābhāve ghaṭākāśakalaśākāśayoryathā|| tamāhuḥ śrutayo brahma evamevaikyamādarāt| yathāgniragnau saṃkṣiptaḥ samānantavamanuvrajet|| tadākhyastanmayo bhūtvā gṛhyate na viśeṣataḥ| yathā tṛṇādikaṃ kṣiptaṃ rumāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ bhavet|| acetanaṃ jagannyastaṃ caitanye cetanībhavet| yathā vai lavaṇagranthiḥ samudre saindhavo yathā|| nāmarūpādvinirmuktāḥ praviśyāpaḥ samudratām| yathā jale jalaṃ nyastaṃ kṣīre kṣīraṃ ghṛte ghṛtam|| avinaṣṭā bhavantyete gṛhyante na viśeṣataḥ| tathāhaṃ sarvabhāvena praviṣṭaścetane sati|| nityānande samastajñe pare paramakāraṇe| nityaṃ sarvagataṃ śāntaṃ niravadyaṃ nirañjanam|| niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śuddhaṃ tadbrahmāsmi paraṃ padam| kevalaṃ satyasaṃkalpaṃ śuddhaṃ brahmāsmyahaṃ param|| puṇyapāpavinirmuktaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ param| advitīyaṃ paraṃ jyotirbrahmāsmyānandamadvayam|| evamādiguṇairyuktaṃ sattvādiguṇavarjitam| āviṣṭaṃ sakalaṃ brahma sadā dhyāyetsukarmakṛta|| evamabhyasataḥ puṃso mano'staṃ yāti tatra vai| manasyastaṃ gate tasya svayamātmā prakāśate|| prasāde sarvaduḥkhānāṃ hāniḥ syātsukhamātmani| svayamātmātmanātmānamānandaṃ pratipadyate|| iti te varṇitaṃ sarvaṃ vasiṣṭhasyopadeśitam| anena jñānamārgeṇa yogamārgeṇa putraka|| bharadvāja mahāprājña sarvaṃ jñāsyasi niścitam| parāmarśena śāstrasya guruvākyārthabodhanāt|| abhyāsātsarvasiddhiḥ syāditi vedānuśāsanam| tasmāttvaṃ sarvamutsṛjya kurvabhyāse sthiraṃ manaḥ|| bharadvāja uvāca|| rāmaḥ prāptaḥ paraṃ yogaṃ svātmanātmani he mune| kathaṃ vasiṣṭhadevena vyavahāraḥ paraḥ kṛtaḥ|| iti jñātvāhamapyevamabhyāsārthaṃ yate yathā| tathaiva vyavahāro'pi vyutthāne me bhaviṣyati|| vālmīkiruvāca|| yadā pariṇataḥ sādhuḥ svasvarūpe mahāmanāḥ| viśvāmitrastadovāca vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam|| viśvāmitra uvāca|| he vasiṣṭha mahābhāga brahmaputra mahānasi| gurutvaṃ śaktipātena tatkṣaṇādeva darśitam|| darśanātsparśanācchabdātkṛpayā śiṣyadehake| janayedyaḥ samādeśaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ sa hi deśikaḥ|| rāmo'pyayaṃ viśuddhātmā viraktaḥ svātmanaiva hi| viśrāntimātrākāṅkṣī ca saṃvādātprāptavānpadam|| śiṣyaprajñaiva bodhasya kāraṇaṃ guruvākyataḥ| malatrayamapakvaṃ cetkathaṃ buddhyati pakvavat|| jñānaṃ pratyakṣamevedaṃ guruśiṣyaprayojanam| ubhāvapi tatastajjñau sarveṣāṃ mādṛśāmapi|| idānīṃ kṛpayā rāma vyutthānaṃ kartumarhasi| pareṇa paratastvaṃ hi kāryāviṣṭo'rcayaṃ yataḥ|| smara kāryaṃ mama vibho yaduddiśyāhamāgataḥ| prārthitaścātikaṣṭena rājā daśarathaḥ svayam|| tadvṛthā mā kṛthāḥ sarvaṃ śuddhena manasā mune| devakāryaṃ ca rāmānyadavatāraprayojanam|| siddhāśramaṃ mayānīto ramo rākṣasamardanaḥ| kariṣyati tato'halyāmuktiṃ ca janakātmajām|| pariṇeṣyati kodaṇḍabhaṅgena kṛtaniścayaḥ| rāmasya jāmadagnyasya kartā naiścityamātmanaḥ|| pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ tyakṣyate'traiva niḥspṛhaḥ| vanavāsacchaleneva daṇkāraṇyavāsinaḥ|| uddhiriṣyati tīrthāni prāṇino duḥkhino hi ye| sītāharaṇadaurgatyacchalena bhuvi śocyatām|| darśayiṣyati sarveṣāṃ rāvaṇādivadhādapi| strīsaṅgināṃ samāsaṅga vānarādiparārthatām|| sītāviśuddhimanvicchaṃllokānugatamātmanaḥ| jīvanmukto niḥspṛho'pi kriyākāṇḍaparāyaṇaḥ|| bhaviṣyati paripraṣṭuṃ jñānakarmasamuccayam| yairdṛṣṭo yaiḥ smṛto vāpi yaiḥ śruto bodhitastu yaiḥ| sarvāvasthāgatānāṃ tu jīvanmuktiṃ pradāsyati|| iti kāryamaśeṣeṇa trailokyasya samāpi hi| anena rāmacandreṇa puruṣeṇa mahātmanā|| namo'smai jitamevaite ko'pyevaṃ ciramedhatām| vasiṣṭha kṛpayā tvaṃ hi vyavahāraṃ paraṃ kuru|| vālmīkiruvāca|| ityukvāvasthitastūṣṇīṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ| vasiṣṭhastu mahātejā rāmacandramabhāṣata|| vasiṣṭha uvāca|| rāma rāma mahābāho mahāpuruṣa cinmaya| nāyaṃ viśrāntikālo hi lokānandamayo bhava|| yāvallokaparāmarśo nirūḍho nāsti yoginaḥ| tāvadrūḍhasamādhitvaṃ na bhavatyeva nirmalam|| tasmādrājyādiviṣayānparyālocya vinaśvarān| devakāryādibhārāṃśca tyaja putra sukhī bhava|| vālmīkīruvāca|| ityukto'pi yadā rāmaḥ kiṃcinnoce layaṃ gataḥ| tathā suṣumnayā so'pi praviṣṭo hṛdayaṃ śanaiḥ|| śaktiprāṇamanaḥpraśāntakaraṇo jīvaprakāśātmako nāḍīrandhrasuṣuptasarvakaraṇaḥ pronmīlya netre śanaiḥ| hṛṣṭotkṛṣṭavasiṣṭhamukhyaviduṣo nirmuktasarvaiṣaṇaḥ kṛtyākṛtyavicāraṇādvirahitaḥ sarvānpratīkṣya sthitaḥ|| rāma uvāca|| na vidhirna niṣedhaśca tvatprasādādahaṃ punaḥ| tathāpi tava vākyaṃ tatkaraṇīyaṃ ca sarvadā|| vedāgamapurāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi mahāmune| guruvākyaṃ vidhiḥ prokto niṣedhastadviparyayaḥ|| vālmīkiruvāca|| ityuktvā caraṇau tasya vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ| śirasyādhāya sarvātmā sarvānprāha ghṛṇānidhiḥ|| sarve śṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo niścayena suniścitam| ātmajñānātparaṃ nāsti gurorapi ca tadvidaḥ|| siddhā ūcuḥ|| rāmaivameva sarveṣāṃ manasi sthitimāgatam| tvatprasādācca sakalaṃ saṃvādena dṛḍhīkṛtam|| sukhī bhava mahārāja rāmacandra namo'stu te| vasiṣṭhenāpyanujñātā gacchāmo'dya yathāgatam|| evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve rāmasaṃstavane ratāḥ| rāmacandrasya śirasi pauṣpī vṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha|| vālmīkiruvāca|| etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ rāmacandrakathānakam| anena kramayogeṇa bharadvāja sukhī bhava|| iti raghupatisiddhiḥ proditā yā mayā te varamunivacanālīratnamālā vicitrā| nikhilakavikulānāṃ yogināṃ sevyarūpā paramagurukaṭākṣānmuktimārgaṃ dadāti|| ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ vidhiṃ rāmavasiṣṭhayoḥ| sarvāvastho'pi śravaṇānmuktimārgaṃ nigacchati|| iha vairāgyamumukṣuvyavahārotpattikasthitayaḥ| upaśamanirvāṇākhye vāsiṣṭhe ṣaṭ prakaraṇāni|| iti śrītarkavāgīśvarasāhityācāryagauḍamaṇḍalālāṃkāraśrīmadabhinandapaṇḍitasamuddhṛte vāsiṣṭharāmāyaṇe mokṣopāye sāroddhāre bharadvājopākhyāne nirvāṇaprakaraṇe śrīvasiṣṭharāmacandrasaṃvādo nāma aṣṭādaśaḥ sargaḥ|| 18 || samāpto'yaṃ granthaḥ||
